name: com.sqlitehost.runtime
description: SqliteHost C# runtime and abstractions (netstandard2.0, Unity-2021-safe): script envelope DTOs, SQLite adapter interfaces, host definition + fluent method descriptors, schema generation, and script execution. No native SQLite dependency — plug in an adapter implementing ISqliteHostConnectionFactory. Sources are synced copies of csharp/SqliteHost.Abstractions and csharp/SqliteHost.Runtime (see unity/sync.mjs).

samples.description: Generated sample host (Example.Game.Generated) plus a SmokeBehaviour MonoBehaviour that builds the host definition and runs a clean-skip script through SqliteHostRuntime with fake handlers and a fake in-memory connection factory — no native SQLite plugin required.
